title: Catalog of Second Chances (CSC) - Digital Database and Corresponding Interfaces for ReUse of Architectural Components (v0.6.4.3)
description:
The Catalog of Second Chances (CSC) is a prototypical digital component database. It catalogs digital representations of uniquely identifiable architectural components for reuse. Furthermore, it provides corresponding interfaces and tools to leverage them via a backend REST-API, a web-frontend as well as a interface for direct interaction within Rhino Grasshopper.

Changes in v0.6.4.3 (2026-10-29)

Photo controls that follow the permission rule. The Grasshopper fixes announced for 0.6.4.3 move to 0.6.4.4.

Fixed

  • Photos of a version: the "Take photo", "Add from gallery" and delete controls on the component page now follow the same rule as the server. Before publish, the author of a draft and the moderators of its dataset add and remove photos, and only moderators on a pending version. After publish, contributors and moderators of the dataset add photos and only moderators remove them. Until now only site admins saw these controls, and only before publish (#45).

Server notes

  • No server step needed.
